title: Failed passive-discovery bind leaks its socket
description:
indigo_uni_io.c:1045-1077 and 1094-1116: passive-discovery bind failure logs but does not close udp_socket on either POSIX or Windows. Repeated failed discovery on an occupied/unusable port leaks a socket each attempt. Next: Close socket on every path after successful socket creation. Verify bind-failure cleanup with a controlled occupied local socket in an authorized test.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-20261023101753-bc8d-complete-repository-audit-014.json (category: functional, blocking: no).
